title: MZ Help Hiding Guest Actors In Menus

posts.author: Oggy
posts.body:
Hi, so I have guest actors who join your party for certain parts of the game, mostly to help in the area you are working in. They do help in combat but are uncontrollable, Dragon Quest 7 style.
My problem is I want to hide them in the menu and other scenes like equip, skills, ect. when not in battle. Is there a somewhat easy way to do this or a plugin suggestion that can handle it?

posts.body:
Take a look here
Party System plugin for RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Use pre-battle and post-battle common events to add and remove them before and after battles, LOL.
